$comment: Project .claude/settings.json fragment: keep the GitNexus index on HEAD after commits, merges and checkouts. The hook only runs for git commands that change HEAD; analyze preserves embeddings if previously generated.

hooks.command: sh -c 'case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git commit"*|*"git merge"*|*"git checkout"*|*"git switch"*|*"git pull"*) npx gitnexus analyze >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac'
